verses.en: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.pt: Em ti, Senhor, me refugio; nunca seja eu confundido.
verses.en_web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed.

verses.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.pt: Na tua justiça socorre-me e livra-me; inclina os teus ouvidos para mim, e salva-me.
verses.en_web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
verses.en_bbe: Keep me safe in your righteousness, and come to my help; give ear to my voice, and be my saviour.

verses.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.pt: Sê tu para mim uma rocha de refúgio a que sempre me acolha; deste ordem para que eu seja salvo, pois tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza.
verses.en_web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.en_bbe: Be my strong Rock, the strong place of my salvation; for you are my Rock, and my safe place.

verses.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.pt: Livra-me, Deus meu, da mão do ímpio, do poder do homem injusto e cruel,
verses.en_web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.en_bbe: O my God, take me out of the hand of the sinner, out of the hand of the evil and cruel man.

verses.en: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.pt: Pois tu és a minha esperança, Senhor Deus; tu és a minha confiança desde a minha mocidade.
verses.en_web: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.
verses.en_bbe: For you are my hope, O Lord God; I have had faith in you from the time when I was young.

verses.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.pt: Em ti me tenho apoiado desde que nasci; tu és aquele que me tiraste das entranhas de minha mãe. O meu louvor será teu constantemente.
verses.en_web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
verses.en_bbe: You have been my support from the day of my birth; you took me out of my mother's body; my praise will be ever of you.

verses.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.pt: Sou para muitos um assombro, mas tu és o meu refúgio forte.
verses.en_web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
verses.en_bbe: I am a wonder to all; but you are my strong tower.

verses.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.pt: A minha boca se enche do teu louvor e da tua glória continuamente.
verses.en_web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
verses.en_bbe: My mouth will be full of your praise and glory all the day.

verses.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.pt: Não me enjeites no tempo da velhice; não me desampares, quando se forem acabando as minhas forças.
verses.en_web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give me up when I am old; be my help even when my strength is gone.

verses.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.pt: Porque os meus inimigos falam de mim, e os que espreitam a minha vida consultam juntos,
verses.en_web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
verses.en_bbe: For my haters are waiting secretly for me; and those who are watching for my soul are banded together in their evil designs,

verses.en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.pt: dizendo: Deus o desamparou; persegui-o e prendei-o, pois não há quem o livre.
verses.en_web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, God has given him up; go after him and take him, for he has no helper.

verses.en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, não te alongues de mim; meu Deus, apressa-te em socorrer-me.
verses.en_web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
verses.en_bbe: O God, be not far from me; O my God, come quickly to my help.

verses.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.pt: Sejam envergonhados e consumidos os meus adversários; cubram-se de opróbrio e de confusão aqueles que procuram o meu mal.
verses.en_web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
verses.en_bbe: Let those who say evil against my soul be overcome and put to shame; let my haters be made low and have no honour.

verses.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.pt: Mas eu esperarei continuamente, e te louvarei cada vez mais.
verses.en_web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
verses.en_bbe: But I will go on ever hoping, and increasing in all your praise.

verses.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.pt: A minha boca falará da tua justiça e da tua salvação todo o dia, posto que não conheça a sua grandeza.
verses.en_web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
verses.en_bbe: My mouth will make clear your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for they are more than may be measured.

verses.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.pt: Virei na força do Senhor Deus; farei menção da tua justiça, da tua tão somente.
verses.en_web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
verses.en_bbe: I will give news of the great acts of the Lord God; my words will be of your righteousness, and of yours only.

verses.en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.pt: Ensinaste-me, ó Deus, desde a minha mocidade; e até aqui tenho anunciado as tuas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
verses.en_bbe: O God, you have been my teacher from the time when I was young; and I have been talking of your works of wonder even till now.

verses.en: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.pt: Agora, quando estou velho e de cabelos brancos, não me desampares, ó Deus, até que tenha anunciado a tua força a esta geração, e o teu poder a todos os vindouros.
verses.en_web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
verses.en_bbe: Now when I am old and grey-headed, O God, give me not up; till I have made clear your strength to this generation, and your power to all those to come.

verses.en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
verses.pt: A tua justiça, ó Deus, atinge os altos céus; tu tens feito grandes coisas; ó Deus, quem é semelhante a ti?
verses.en_web: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
verses.en_bbe: Your righteousness, O God, is very high; you have done great things; O God, who is like you?

verses.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.pt: Tu, que me fizeste ver muitas e penosas tribulações, de novo me restituirás a vida, e de novo me tirarás dos abismos da terra.
verses.en_web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: You, who have sent great and bitter troubles on me, will give me life again, lifting me up from the deep waters of the underworld.

verses.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.pt: Aumentarás a minha grandeza, e de novo me consolarás.
verses.en_web: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
verses.en_bbe: You will make me greater than before, and give me comfort on every side.

verses.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.pt: Também eu te louvarei ao som do saltério, pela tua fidelidade, ó meu Deus; cantar-te-ei ao som da harpa, ó Santo de Israel.
verses.en_web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: I will give praise to you with instruments of music, O my God, for you are true; I will make songs to you with music, O Holy One of Israel.

verses.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.pt: Os meus lábios exultarão quando eu cantar os teus louvores, assim como a minha alma, que tu remiste.
verses.en_web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
verses.en_bbe: Joy will be on my lips when I make melody to you; and in my soul, to which you have given salvation.

verses.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.pt: Também a minha língua falará da tua justiça o dia todo; pois estão envergonhados e confundidos aqueles que procuram o meu mal.
verses.en_web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
verses.en_bbe: My tongue will be talking of your righteousness all the day; for those whose purpose is to do me evil have been crushed and put to shame.
